summary: Tower Semiconductor Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results. Revenue was $414 million, up 15% year-over-year, with gross profit of $111 million and net profit of $65 million ($0.58 basic EPS). The company guided Q2 2026 revenue to a record $455 million, with sequential growth expected throughout the year. The press release also references a previously announced restructuring in Japan toward full ownership of Fab 7 and strong customer commitments in silicon photonics. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation transaction or corporate action.
